plugins.cameraPermission: Rakshika needs camera access to record silent video evidence during an SOS emergency.
plugins.microphonePermission: Rakshika needs microphone access to record audio evidence during an SOS emergency.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Rakshika uses your location to share it with emergency contacts and responders during an SOS alert.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Rakshika to access your location in the background so emergency alerts include your live GPS position.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Rakshika uses your location to display safe routes and share your position during emergencies.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Rakshika uses your location to share with emergency contacts.
